steps.text: Tap Activity to see every transaction. The top shows what you spent, what came in, and the difference for the month.
Use the arrows to move between months.
Tap Expenses to see only money going out.
Tap Income for money coming in.
Tap All to see everything again.
Tap a transaction to open it.
Here you see the amount, the date, and the line from your statement.
Tap back to return to the list.
